This dataset contains one (1) point cloud file created from two hundred and thirty-seven (237) images collected by the Capture2Preserv team with the Sensefly Ebee Geo Fixed Wing Drone. The images were processed in Pix4D and exported in E57 format and converted into a las format with Cloud Compare.
